method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: flat plank, low-poly clods, no visible flagging, mid-tone crust
notes.fix: crop to about 0.5 m on the foot and hole, chamfered grained pine with limp tied flagging, a tight pool

notes.problem: untextured slab, low-poly clods, tiled crust, mid-tone ground
notes.fix: chamfered grained lath with limp flagging at its head, camera about 0.4 m, pool tight on the foot

notes.problem: untextured slab by low-poly clods, empty crust above
notes.fix: pine grain, sharpened point, wet clay foot, tied flagging, eye 0.5 m so the foot and hole fill the lower two thirds

notes.problem: pale primitive a fifth of the frame on the horizon against black
notes.fix: tighten so the plant spans a third of the width, a hard rim from the left, the line still leading to it

notes.problem: small pale flat-lit unit on a ruled horizon against black, the line entering lower right
notes.fix: mirror the camera so the line enters lower left, fov about 12, a key pool on its left flank, sky haze falling to dark

notes.problem: pale primitive boxes about a tenth of the frame, no pool or contact
notes.fix: about 120 m at eye 1.6 m, fov 18, side-lit with the key, contact under the skids, the line ending at its fence

notes.problem: flat ribbon outline with a black band, nothing of known size, road and channel imply placement
notes.fix: a lit stake-and-string perimeter casting right, a semi at the near corner, the channel pulled off the far edge

notes.problem: a 2D diagram at feed size with a black channel band and a dashed road
notes.fix: eye about 250 m at a lower oblique, the near corner in a lit pool with grass and a modelled shoulder, riprap with a specular water edge

notes.problem: ribbon on a noise texture, flat black channel, nothing of known size
notes.fix: riprap and water with the seam reflected, the near corner and shoulder in a pool, a tractor-trailer for scale

notes.problem: dead wall between dek and dais, box chairs, no window
notes.fix: raise and tilt down so rows and dais fill from y 900, a left-wall window as a cool rim

notes.problem: the chairs appear to face the camera
notes.fix: rotate the rows 180 degrees so the backs face the camera

notes.problem: a generic lectern reusing 7's kit for Brownsville's copy
notes.fix: a Brownsville object in the deck's vocabulary in a single-lamp pool

notes.problem: sticker-flat face with no town name, reflectors in a lane
notes.fix: STARBASE above CITY LIMIT, retroreflective falloff, reflectors on the centre line
